associated_studies: Legagneux et al. 2012 Proc R Soc B 10.1098/rspb.2011.1351

purpose: Determine whether public Dryad files permit a source-faithful reanalysis that isolates a duration-dependent D-like perturbation axis more narrowly than the published all-treatment summary.

preregistered_next_design_if_fields_exis.primary_subset: fed-captivity birds plus immediate-release controls; exclude fasting treatment from primary
preregistered_next_design_if_fields_exis.exposure: captivity/delay duration fixed before reproductive outcome
preregistered_next_design_if_fields_exis.rationale: remove deliberate energetic deprivation while retaining elapsed captivity duration; confinement/handling stress remains a stated residual confound
preregistered_next_design_if_fields_exis.primary_claim_ceiling: duration-dependent reproductive carry-over under fed/control conditions is a D-like time/stress calibration, not pure PAYOFF-B opportunity cost D
forbidden: do not select years based on effect significance
do not use 2009 only as primary because it has the strongest published effect
do not call captivity hours natural waiting cost D
do not combine with GPS q_wait outcome before a separate joint preregistration

gate: Inspect public file manifest and documentation before freezing exact columns, endpoint, random effects, and uncertainty estimator.
